title: Backup
description: M4: backups and restore between panel and agent. An archive is `<server>/backups/<backupId>.tar.zst` on the host (tar, zstd-compressed) with a sidecar `<backupId>.json` (`BackupSidecar`); entries are `gss-backup.json` (`BackupManifest`) first, then `data/…` and, for stacks, `services/<name>/…`. One operation (create or restore) per server at a time; it runs detached from the panel connection, reports `backup.progress` (dropped while the panel is away) and exactly one `backup.finished` (kept until delivered), and shows in `ServerStatus.operation` while it runs.

BACKUP_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SEC.description: Most one `backup.progress` per operation per this many seconds.

BACKUP_SETTLE_SEC.description: Wait after the definition's `backup.before` console commands before the archive starts (the game flushes its saves).

BACKUP_FORMAT_VERSION.description: `BackupManifest.format`; a restore refuses archives with a higher one.

x-messages.description: Archive the data folder (minus the spec's `backup.exclude`) and every stack service volume. While the game runs: `backup.before` commands, BACKUP_SETTLE_SEC, archive data/, `backup.after` commands (also after a failure); running service containers are paused while their volume is archived (crash-consistent copy). Refused (`conflict`) while installing, while another operation runs, or with too little free disk (`no_space`). Answers when it has begun.

Replace the data folder (and the service volumes the archive holds) with the archive's. Only while the game is stopped, crashed or install_failed (`conflict` otherwise). Extracts beside the live folders, then stops the containers, swaps by rename (journal in `<server>/restore.json`, rolled back at agent startup when interrupted), and starts the game container again (the game stays stopped). Answers when it has begun.
Remove an archive and its sidecar (a missing one is not an error). `conflict` while that backup is being created or restored.
Bytes processed so far, at most every BACKUP_PROGRESS_INTERVAL_SEC. Dropped while the panel is away.
An operation ended (ok or not). Never dropped.

backupId.description: The panel's `backups.id`; the archive is `<backupId>.tar.zst`, so no path ever travels.

BackupOperationStatus.description: The operation a server runs right now.

totalBytes.description: Estimate: create = the last disk measurement of data/ + services/; restore = the sidecar's `bytes`. null when unknown.

sizeBytes.description: create: size of the finished archive; null otherwise.

error.description: Readable cause when not ok, e.g. `The host's disk is full (2.1 GB free, about 6 GB needed).`

running.description: The game was running while the archive was taken (before/after commands were sent).

BackupSidecar.description: `<backupId>.json` next to the archive, written after it is complete; the restore's disk check reads it.

bytes.description: Uncompressed bytes of every regular file archived.
